# Required platform source snapshot

The 56 dependency files listed by ../../build/portable/vendor_requirements.json are included here with exact matching SHA256. They are the accepted local camera-platform dependency set, not a newly downloaded vendor release. Preserve their original copyright notices and third-party licenses. Provenance and unresolved redistribution scope remain in ../../build/vendor_dependency_review.md.

The offline preparation command may use this directory as --vendor-dir. A successful preparation is not a new Vivado build or physical-board experiment.
